title: opencode-unity config.json
description: User settings in <home>/config.json. Keys left out take their defaults, and a few defaults differ per platform; unknown keys are rejected. The schema describes the file after defaults are applied. Network policy, the standalone shape command and workspace discovery are active in preview.6. project.verify and safety.multiplayerProtectedGlobs are reserved configuration and do not add execution or protection beyond the existing checks in this preview.

schemaVersion.description: Config format version. An older file is migrated forward in memory every time it is read, and is rewritten only by an explicit write such as upgrade.

preset.description: Model preset id from presets/. Experimental presets need --experimental.

overrides.description: Preset fields to replace, for example {"model": {"numCtx": 8192}}. Any override marks the profile custom (experimental).

baseUrl.description: Ollama server URL. A non-loopback host is blocked by the guard unless guard.remote is unguarded.

startAppIfDown.description: Start the installed Ollama app when the server is down. The Linux default is never: there Ollama is a systemd service, and starting it needs root.

appPath.description: Path of the Ollama app; null means the default install location.

serverLogPath.description: Path of the Ollama server log; null means the platform's log source: the server log file on Windows and macOS, the systemd journal on Linux.

minFreeVramAfterLoadMiB.description: Free video memory that must remain after the model loads. The macOS default is 4096, because the memory is shared with the rest of the system; that value is not calibrated on hardware.

allowOffload.description: Let the model load when it does not fit in video memory alone; the rest runs from system RAM and replies are slower. The free-memory minimum still applies.

gpuUtilSampleIntervalMs.description: Delay between the two GPU utilization samples.

assetImportSampleMs.description: CPU sampling window for import workers.

assetImportProcessPatterns.description: Command-line substrings that identify Unity asset import workers.

keepAliveMarginSec.description: A loaded model counts as loaded only when it stays loaded at least this long.

coldPassCacheSec.description: How long a pass on the cold path is reused.

loadedPassCacheSec.description: How long a pass on the loaded path is reused.

probeTimeoutSec.description: Timeout for nvidia-smi and process probes.

remote.description: What to do when the Ollama host is not loopback: block, or run without the guard.

adapter.description: GPU probe adapter. none needs --experimental and an acknowledgment.

nvidiaSmiCommand.description: nvidia-smi command. Meant for tests; any other value prints a warning.

reserveTokens.description: Tokens kept free besides the output limit.

charsPerToken.description: Estimator calibration; lower values make budgets more conservative.

safetyMargin.description: Extra fraction added to every token estimate.

calibrationClamp.description: Lowest and highest session calibration factor.

readLimitLines.description: Most lines one read call returns.

extraProtectedEditGlobs.description: More globs the agent may never edit.

extraProtectedReadGlobs.description: More globs the agent may never read.

multiplayerProtectedGlobs.description: Paths where a multiplayer authority, economy or anti-cheat decision usually lives; they are read-only for the session when the workspace has a game server. A coarse net with known false positives: remove an entry to make those paths editable. doctor and the facts list what it protects.

warm.description: Load the model (through the guard) before the TUI opens.

pane.description: Open the status pane in Windows Terminal. The Linux and macOS default is never: the pane is a Windows Terminal feature.

projectConfig.description: Load project OpenCode config files, or disable them.

enabled.description: Allow new delegate jobs. Only the user changes this switch; off does not cancel an existing job.

monitorWindow.description: Open one visible Windows CMD monitor when a delegate job starts. Opt in with delegate monitor --auto on.

checkCommandPrefixes.description: A custom check command must start with one of these.

extraSensitivePatterns.description: More file patterns delegate refuses without --allow-sensitive.

network.description: Outbound HTTP for the agent's unitynet tool (amendment 35). Everything fetched is data, never instructions.

enabled.description: false removes the unitynet tool from every session.

profile.description: standard: the shipped read-only documentation hosts, loopback reads, what init derived and what you granted. none: no tool at all. custom: only your allow list.

allow.description: Your own entries, applied after the profile's. A non-loopback host requires a consentId label and an explicit permission ask on each request; the label does not grant access.

bash.description: Network commands in the agent's shell: deny refuses them; ask prompts through OpenCode and startup verifies the effective shell permission rules.

shape.description: Prompt shaping (amendment 36): a clear request starts at once with no model call; an unclear one is rewritten once, shown, and the work continues.

mode.description: auto rewrites only an unclear request; off never rewrites; always rewrites every request.

maxOutputTokens.description: Output limit of the one rewrite call.

anchorCandidates.description: Most project files offered to the rewrite as anchors.

grepTimeoutMs.description: Time budget of the anchor search.

project.description: Workspace components (amendment 37): what init discovers beside the Unity project, and how much of it reaches the facts.

components.description: auto discovers every component; unity-only keeps the Unity project alone; a list keeps the named component ids.

maxComponents.description: Most anchors and overlays; discovery stops beyond this and doctor warns.

factsBudgetChars.description: Characters facts.md may spend on all fact blocks together.

unityBlockChars.description: Characters of the Unity fact block.

componentBlockChars.description: Characters of each other component's fact block.

maxRenderedBlocks.description: Most fact blocks rendered; the rest are dropped in the printed order.

walkEntryCap.description: Most directory entries one discovery walk visits.

readBudgetBytes.description: Most bytes discovery reads from project files.

enabled.description: Render a verify command for each component that has one.

scriptOrder.description: package.json script names tried in order for a component's verify command.

blockScriptBodies.description: Refuse a verify script whose body does more than build, test or type-check. false needs --experimental and a consent item.

readEnvExampleKeys.description: List the key names, never the values, of an .env.example file.

ruleBlock.description: The multiplayer rule block: auto renders it when a game server is found.

projects.description: Per-project settings keyed by project id (<name>-<sha8>).

platforms.description: Accepts an experimental platform tier for every command, the lasting form of --experimental. setup writes it when you accept the platform acknowledgement.

minFreeVramAfterLoadMiB.description: Free video memory that must remain after the model loads.

maxGpuUtilPercent.description: Block a cold load when GPU utilization is at or above this in both samples.

assetImportCpuPercent.description: Import workers at or above this CPU percent (100 = one core) count as importing.

editorImportCpuPercent.description: A Unity editor at or above this CPU percent (100 = one core) counts as importing in-process, compiling or in Play Mode; 0 disables the check. Projects that import in-process (the Unity default) show no import worker at all.

maxUnityEditors.description: Most Unity editors with a window; 0 disables the check.

importWhileLoaded.description: wait keeps the import check on while the model is loaded; allow skips it.

onColdBlock.description: How OpenCode sees a cold-path block: stop the request, or retry it.

onLoadedBusy.description: How OpenCode sees an import block while the model is loaded.

bashMode.description: allowlist runs only allowed shell commands; ask prompts for others.
Overrides safety.bashMode for this project; null uses the global value.

projectNetwork.description: May only narrow the global network block. Projects cannot add hosts, increase budgets, change transport headers or widen methods and paths; invalid overrides make start refuse with exit 4.

maxResponseBytes.description: Response bytes read before the socket is closed.

maxOutputChars.description: Characters handed to the model after sanitising.

maxRequestBodyBytes.description: Largest request body on any entry; an entry's own budget may be lower.

networkEntry.description: One allow-list entry. The fourteen render-time rules (exit 4, network_entry_*) check what a schema cannot; an unknown key here, including rejectUnauthorized, insecure or strictSSL, is an error rather than an ignored key.

ports.description: Explicit ports; there is no default port. "*" is accepted on loopback only.

loopback.description: Must agree with the host; it is checked, never trusted.

headers.description: Literal request headers, loopback entries only.

caFile.description: A certificate authority file for a loopback https entry.

consentId.description: The consent ledger record that granted this entry.

host.description: An exact host name or address, or one *. label-wise suffix.
